ModMetaData.name: RimFlix Anime Shows 动漫电视秀
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
Anime-style TV shows for RimFlix (Continued). Ships placeholder loops (blob mascot, starry sky) as working examples; drop your own images into Textures/Shows to make real shows. Load after RimFlix.
RimFlix (Continued) 的动漫风电视节目包。自带可播放的占位节目（弹跳团子、星空闪烁）作为示例；把你自己收集的图片放进 Textures/Shows 即可制作真正的节目。请在 RimFlix 之后加载。
